assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, human vastus lateralis (Illumina NovaSeq 6000; STAR GRCh38 + featureCounts)
primary_estimand: Within-subject transcriptome change in vastus lateralis after 10 weeks of unilateral resistance training (2x/week) at low volume (1 set, one leg) and high volume (4 sets, contralateral leg) versus the pre-training biopsy, analyzed by hypertrophy-responder phenotype (low / medium / high responders defined from qCSA change vs 2xTE = 3.27%)
repeated_measure_unit: participant (27 older men and women; 3 biopsies each)
sample_inclusion: 27 older participants (69 +/- 3 yr) from the parental trial; biopsies at baseline and 48 h after the last session from both legs (abstract; GEO overall_design)
planned_contrasts: post-1set vs baseline within each responder group (abstract: high responders hypertrophy after both volumes; low responders no pathway changes)
post-4sets vs baseline within each responder group (abstract)
4 sets vs 1 set (abstract: higher volume increased Frizzled-1 protein, regardless of responder group)
paper_method: RNA-seq GO analysis and PLIER pathway analysis (abstract); DE software and threshold not stated in the abstract
paper_results: pathway-level only: high responders up-regulated protein turnover / RT metabolic / protein-folding pathways; medium responders down-regulated proteasome and spliceosome; low responders no measurable pathway change. No DEG counts in the abstract. Frizzled-1 is a protein (western blot) result.
